summary: Memory OS source layout: core/ (repository.py=graph CRUD, patch.py=RelationPatchStore, config.py), modules/ (search.py=FTS+MemorySearcher, lifecycle.py=decay/promote, validator.py, compactor.py), toolkit/ (agent_comm.py=swarm transport, workspace.py=agent launch+worktrees, dispatcher.py, link_inferrer.py, graph_mapper.py), adapters/ (telegram_polling.py), cli.py=50+ subcommands.

Swarm protocol: agent_comm.py send() → 1) writes inbox/AGENT.jsonl, 2) sends tmux send-keys to pane, 3) on tmux fail: TASK_ASSIGN uses inbox-only fallback (ok=True), STATUS_REPORT returns ok=False. Agents read swarm via tmux pane injection. registry.toml maps agent_id → tmux_target. Bidirectional confirmed: agy↔codex.

Memory graph schema: nodes.jsonl (id, type, summary, status, trust, tags, freshness, evidence). edges.jsonl (src_id, dst_id, relation, weight). Types: fact/rule/policy/strategy/comm. Status: draft→observed→verified→stale/superseded. Trust: unverified/extracted/inferred/system. SQLite FTS5 synced via sync command. Comm:* nodes excluded from link-infer.

Agent registry: agent_context/agents/registry.toml. Agents: claude (pane 0.0), codex (pane 0.1), agy (pane 0.2). Each has: kind, command, capabilities, cost_class, context_window, risk_max, tmux_target, system_prompt_file. Local models: local-router/local-responder (ollama qwen3:4b). Scripts: memory-os-cli, shell.

Task lifecycle: created→running→done/blocked. Stored in agent_context/task_events.jsonl. Done signal: agent_context/done/TASK_ID.json. Inbox: agent_context/inbox/AGENT.jsonl. Feed: all events timestamped. task list shows all tasks with status. STATUS_REPORT writes done/ file automatically. Tasks survive restarts.

Open items after memory efficiency pass (2026-07-01): 1) Fix 34x datetime.utcnow() → datetime.now(UTC) across src/. 2) Retrieval eval suite: Q→nodes→recall@5. 3) Curated knowledge: graph has 5 knowledge nodes vs 208 comm-noise. 4) agy tmux wake: inbox delivery works, live wake situationally fails (currently OK). 5) Graph too sparse: 1 edge, diameter 1.

Collaboration protocol agy+codex: codex handles implementation (code edit, tests, datetime fixes, eval suites), agy handles architecture review, knowledge curation, swarm coordination, tmux audit. Communication via swarm send(), bidirectional confirmed 2026-07-01. Task division via TASK_ASSIGN messages with explicit split.
